text:
maya: quick RFC follow-up: proposing a "two-tier" pacing model for onboarding to avoid bench storms. intake-level soft budget + prober local backoff.

tom: sounds good. what signals for intake? token-weighted rps?

maya: yes. cost = ingest_qps * expected_token_cost; convert to probe allowance. keep it soft (best-effort) so we don't fail deterministically.

zuri: prober-side: prioritize golden inputs and cap unique prefixes in-flight. evict non-golden prefixes first when kv_util high.

sam: need to preserve deterministic correctness checks (tokenizer parity, logits sanity). pacing only affects perf probes. record effective_probe_plan with model artifact.

maya: agree. also add a per-model seqlen_hint so registry can suggest longer-budget models.

tom: simulation plan?

sam: i'll produce two traces: steady and rush (200 models in 10m). success targets: golden_coverage >= 0.8 within 30m for 90% models; kv_miss_rate < 5%; onboarding P99 down 30% vs baseline.

ops-bot: staging: intake-pacer v0.1 enabled on prebench queue.

zuri: action items: maya draft slim RFC + config schema; sam generate traces and run sim; tom prototype prefix buckets; i'll write acceptance checks.

maya: will post RFC by Thu EOD. drop comments here if you need added constraints (per-customer fairness, dedicated-pool overrides, etc.). :thumbsup:
